summary: Easy ABC Language School in South Pattaya teaches German, English, Thai and Russian in group, private and online formats, and offers ED visa study, translations and apartments.

facts.label: Founded
facts.quote: On March 1st, 2008, the Easy ABC Language School was founded in Pattaya under German management

facts.label: Licence
facts.value: Audited and certified as a language school by the Thai Ministry of Education in 2009
facts.quote: In 2009, Easy ABC was audited by the Thai Ministry of Education and officially certified as a language school.

facts.label: Languages taught
facts.quote: We currently teach the following languages: German, English, Thai and Russian.

facts.label: ED visa
facts.quote: This is possible with an ED Visa (eligible ages: 12 to 49 years old).

facts.label: Thai levels
facts.value: Thai speaking and writing for beginners and advanced
facts.quote: *Thai speaking and writing for beginners & advanced

facts.label: Apartments
facts.value: Apartments in Pattaya for holiday or long-term stays
facts.quote: If you are looking for a nice and clean apartment in Pattaya for vacation or long term, we have the right offer for you.
